modules.ipIntel: Country, region, approximate city · ISP, organization, ASN · Reverse DNS and RDAP network range · Optional VPN/proxy/Tor/hosting indicators through your own API keys
modules.domainIntel: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) · RDAP/WHOIS registrar and dates · TLS certificate issuer, validity, SANs · Hosting ASN
modules.osint: IP, domain, username, email and hash targets · Lawful public sources only · Source, time and local/external label for every result
modules.reputation: Optional VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Shodan and Censys lookups · Hash lookups before any upload · Uploads only with explicit confirmation
modules.securityCenter: Quick, full, file and folder scans through Microsoft Defender · Engine and definition status · Combined verdict with YARA and static analysis
modules.yara: Local YARA-X engine · Scan files and folders · Rule manager, rule packs, custom rules · Matched rule, namespace, tags and metadata
modules.passwordRecovery: ZIP, 7z, PDF and Office files you own or are authorized to test · Wordlist, mask and candidate-list modes · Progress, speed, pause, resume and stop · Recovered passwords are never written to logs
modules.windowsForensics: Processes with signature and hash · Services, drivers, startup entries, scheduled tasks · Users, groups, installed software · Event logs · Elevation requested only when needed
modules.networkToolkit: Ping, DNS and reverse DNS, traceroute · Adapters, routes, ARP · Active connections and listening ports · Basic port checks on networks you are authorized to test
modules.threatHunting: Search by hash, IP, domain, filename, process, service · Persistence indicators · Correlated timeline across modules
modules.cases: Local cases (CASE-YYYY-NNN) · Evidence kept separate from analyst notes · Tags, timeline and evidence metadata
modules.reports: HTML and JSON reports in Arabic or English · Case, findings, indicators and hashes · No machine identifiers unless you choose to include them
modules.engines: Microsoft Defender detection and status · YARA-X engine and rule packs · Password recovery engine locations

file.title: File Analyzer

file.dropHint: or choose one — any size, it is streamed from disk.
file.name: Name

pe.title: PE structure
pe.parseError: PE header could not be parsed: {{reason}}

file.entropyNote: High entropy suggests compression or encryption — common in legitimate installers too.
file.noIocs: No embedded URLs, domains, IPs or emails found.
file.stringsNote: Scanned the first {{size}} of the file.
file.incompleteNote: Some engines did not run. This is not a guarantee that the file is safe.
file.enginesMissing: Engines not used in this analysis
file.falsePositives: Heuristics can produce false positives. Review the evidence before acting.
file.quarantineBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from its location and stored neutralized in quarantine. You can restore it later.
file.hashRepNote: External lookup: only the SHA-256 hash is sent. The file is never uploaded.

desc.no_detections: The engines that ran found nothing of concern.
desc.unknown: Not enough evidence either way — important engines did not run.
desc.suspicious: Several indicators combined deserve a closer look.
desc.malicious: A detection engine flagged this file.

reason.signature_mismatch: The digital signature does not match the file contents
reason.unsigned_executable: The executable is not digitally signed
reason.signature_untrusted: The signature is present but not trusted
reason.high_entropy: High overall entropy ({{value}} bits/byte) — possible packing or encryption
reason.interesting_strings: {{count}} strings reference script hosts or persistence locations
reason.vt_malicious: VirusTotal: {{count}} engines flag this file as malicious
reason.vt_suspicious: VirusTotal: {{count}} engines flag this file as suspicious
reason.vt_clean: VirusTotal: known file, no engine flags it
